issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 28,669.03 (Waste Water & Sewer Fund) + 300.00 (Sewer Cust. Utility Deposits)
issues.issue: These are the only receipts of the sewer utility fund, so they are probably sewer charges and customer deposits. 'Local Receipts: Other' is a context label, and the page needs checking before it can be categorized. The same applies to detail[25] and detail[26].

beginning_investments (59,806.68) and ending_investments are filled even though they are already included in beginning_cash (line 3) and ending_cash (line 24). Anything that adds cash and investments together will count them twice. Cody_FY2022 leaves the investments null instead, so the two reports are inconsistent.
ending_cash is the line 24 Ending Balance, which includes investments, rather than a cash line. Line 26 Net Cash Balance for the governmental columns is 98,914.39.
